baryon_free_validation.detail: local log-log slope of u(r), measured away from either boundary, transitions -0.4487 -> -2.1694 -> -2.5066 -> -2.1423 -> -2.0198 approaching r_far, confirming the solver reproduces the known regular-isothermal-sphere asymptotic behavior

r_far_convergence_test.detail: non-monotonic, non-convergent across r_far for 2 of 3 galaxies even with continuation (using the previous r_far's solution as the next initial guess); NGC2403 failed outright (mesh node limit exceeded) at mult=50; DDO154 jumped to a saturated branch (u_max=0.99996) at mult=50 then failed at mult=100; NGC3198 collapsed to a solution ~4 orders of magnitude smaller at mult=50 then failed at mult=100. Only NGC3198's mult=15/25 pair (without continuation) agreed within ~20%.
